questions.q: How does the summary suggest leaders should see their role?
a: As stewardship of their people's well-being
As control over daily tasks and output
As a reward for top performers
As a system of strict accountability
questions.why: Lesson 1 says leadership should go beyond tradition and become stewardship.

questions.q: What does responsible freedom look like at work?
a: Define what winning means, then let people decide how
Let employees set their own salaries and hours
Remove all goals, deadlines and measurements
Promote only people who have been there longest
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes the just enough strategy of clear goals plus autonomy.

questions.q: What did Design Group do before setting a growth goal?
a: Put existing employees first and improved the workplace
Cut staff in order to protect its profits
Opened offices in several new countries
Hired an outside turnaround firm
questions.why: Lesson 3 says they focused on people before planning to double.

questions.q: How should a leader show genuine care, per lesson 1?
a: Talk with employees and learn about their lives
Ask mainly about their productivity numbers
Send regular company-wide memos
Offer occasional cash bonuses
questions.why: Lesson 1 warns that asking only about output shows narrow concern.

questions.q: What does cultural visioning ask a team to consider?
a: Where they want to be in a few years and why
Which competitors they should acquire
How to cut costs this quarter
Which employees deserve promotion
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to start with the destination, then examine the reason.
